evaluation_boundary.evaluators: isolated agents received test inputs only and did not inspect repository fixtures or expected answers
evaluation_boundary.engine_execution_reason: load_skill returns engine.py as a reference and declares supporting_code_execution not_executed; the exposed MCP has no code-execution tool
evaluation_boundary.result_type: independent host-model interpretation of the deployed skill instructions, with arithmetic cross-checked by local unit/CI tests; not a Site-side Python engine receipt

checks.case: separate uncovered value from validated whitespace
checks.observed: With top-down TAM 1000, bottom-up TAM 1200, segment SAM 100, served value 20, and no separate unmet-demand evidence, the skill reported 80 as uncovered serviceable value and left validated whitespace unknown.

checks.case: sourced unmet demand and transferability boundary
checks.observed: With separately evidenced unmet demand 30, the skill distinguished validated whitespace 30 from uncovered serviceable value 80. In a separate no-source request it refused to quantify TAM or transfer a European share to Poland without local evidence.

checks.case: profit-pool, PVM, driver-tree and cost-bridge example
checks.observed: Revenue 300, operating profit 50, aggregate margin 16.67%; PVM prior/current revenue 300/308 with volume 0, mix -20, price +28; driver tree 30 = 10 + 20; cost change 45 - 40 = +5.
checks.limitation: The isolated prompt did not include explicit period labels/comparability evidence; output was manually calculated from the loaded instructions, not produced by engine.py.

checks.case: future evidence and unreconciled driver tree
checks.observed: The skill rejected operating-profit evidence published after the as-of date and flagged parent 30 versus children 10 + 21 as unreconciled by +1.
Forecast 1000 versus actual 800 for the same KPI period produced variance -200 and -20%; the 30-day review was due and sourced thresholds produced CORRECT_REVIEW with human decision required.
With no dated forecast/actual evidence, cadence, last review, or approved thresholds, the skill returned NOT_CONFIGURED/insufficient evidence and did not stop work or claim causality.

release_decision: The exact current packages loaded successfully and representative behavior was manually observed. Deterministic Python engines were not executed through the Site MCP; source and full local/CI test suites cover those calculations. The market-economics campaign remains NOT_RUN for its full declared suite and release approval remains false.
